summary: The note describes the Upper Mississippi River Valley AVA, an American Viticultural Area along the Upper Mississippi River and its tributaries spanning northwest Illinois, northeast Iowa, southeast Minnesota and southwest Wisconsin. It was certified by the Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau on July 22, 2009, and is the largest AVA in the United States, about 50 times larger than the Bordeaux wine regions of France.
one_line: The Upper Mississippi River Valley AVA is a 2009-certified American wine region spanning four Midwestern states and the largest AVA in the United States.
key_facts: The Upper Mississippi River Valley AVA is an American Viticultural Area.
The Upper Mississippi River Valley AVA covers 29,914 square miles (77,477 square kilometers, or 19,144,960 acres).
The AVA is located along the Upper Mississippi River and its tributaries.
The Upper Mississippi River Valley AVA spans northwest Illinois, northeast Iowa, southeast Minnesota and southwest Wisconsin.
The Upper Mississippi River Valley AVA was certified by the United States Department of the Treasury's Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau.
The Upper Mississippi River Valley AVA was certified on July 22, 2009.
The Upper Mississippi River Valley AVA is the largest AVA in the United States.
The Upper Mississippi River Valley AVA encompasses an area 50 times larger than the Bordeaux wine regions of France.
